description: This file defines a class 'MtJpGraphRenderer' that extends a base renderer class for chart rendering using the JPGraph package within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It initializes the external JPGraph library by loading various graph types.

classes.name: MtJpGraphRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for creating charts using the JPGraph library, initializing and loading specific graph types on demand.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the JPGraph library by loading various types of graphs if not already loaded.
